requirements.general_text: Entry Levels and Requirements Foundation: Completion with a CGPA of 2.00, including Mathematics, and science and 1 any other subject, or its equivalent A Level: 2 principal passes in any 2 science subjects STPM: 2 grade C in any 2 subjects, or its equivalent; and possess SPM with 3 credits in Mathematics, 1 science subject and 1 any other subject SACE: ATAR of 70 and possess SPM/ its equivalent with 3 credits in Mathematics, 1 science subject and 1 any other subject NSW (HSC): ATAR of 70 and possess SPM/ its equivalent with 3 credits in Mathematics, 1 science subject and 1 any other subject Australian Year 12: ATAR of 70 and possess SPM/ its equivalent with 3 credits in Mathematics, 1 science subject and 1 any other subject UEC: 5Bs including Mathematics and 1 science subject CPU: 6 subjects with minimum average score of 68 and possess SPM/its equivalent with 3 credits in Mathematics, 1 science subject and 1 any other subject Matriculation in related fields: Programme with a CGPA of 2.00, or its equivalent, and possess SPM with 3 credit in Mathematics, 1 science subject and 1 any other subject
